name: African Market OS MVR Preflight Agent
description: Delegate here before recommending that an organization enter, launch, invest, fund, partner, procure, deploy, or scale in an African or high-context market when local trust, stakeholder permission, embeddedness, guardian or regulatory acceptance, reciprocity, legitimacy, or evidence sufficiency may change the decision. Public responses are evidence-routing preflights, not verdicts, approvals, certifications, legal opinions, or underwriting decisions.

skills.name: Market-entry permission preflight
skills.description: Identify the local evidence, stakeholder, guardian, permission, and abstention checks required before an agent recommends entering, launching, partnering, or scaling in an African or high-context market.
examples: Should this fintech expand into Uganda?
What must be proven before this retailer enters Kenya?
We have a strong product and two distributor meetings. Can we recommend launch in Ghana?

skills.name: Investor relational diligence
skills.description: Route an investment or funding question through relational evidence and permission checks before an AI produces a confident investment recommendation.
examples: What relational evidence is missing before we recommend investment?
Should our investment committee fund this Nigeria retail platform on founder-reported traction?
The financial model works. What local permission evidence could still invalidate the deal?

skills.name: NGO and DFI deployment readiness
skills.description: Identify stakeholder, guardian, reciprocity, local-legitimacy, and field-evidence gaps before a program is recommended for deployment.
examples: Can this NGO safely deploy this program in Northern Nigeria?
What must a DFI verify before scaling this livelihood program across Uganda?
The ministry is supportive, but community evidence is thin. Should deployment proceed?

skills.name: Fintech rollout readiness
skills.description: Identify permission, regulatory, custody, credit, guardian, and local evidence gaps before a fintech rollout recommendation.
examples: Is this wallet rollout ready for Uganda?
Can we recommend launching merchant credit in Kenya before the custody partner is verified?
Which guardian and regulatory evidence is missing from this cross-border payments plan?

skills.name: Stakeholder evidence completeness
skills.description: Check whether supplied evidence is sufficiently verified, diverse, geographically relevant, and stakeholder-complete to proceed to a bounded decision check.
examples: Do we have enough evidence to decide yet?
Does this evidence pack rely too heavily on founder and management claims?
Are the sources verified, geographically relevant, and diverse enough for a bounded decision?

skills.name: Reckless-GO risk detection
skills.description: Surface when an agent is about to convert thin, self-reported, stale, or geographically mismatched evidence into an overconfident go recommendation.
examples: Should the agent abstain instead of recommending launch?
Is this recommendation laundering self-reported traction into a GO decision?
Would proceeding here be a Reckless-GO because the decisive evidence is stale or geographically mismatched?
